summary: Regression pass after the Doctor Dashboard hotfix (missing `import { useChat } from '@/src/store/chat'` at app/(doctor)/index.tsx and formatting fix at app/inbox.tsx:9). Confirmed the imports are now present and code is clean. Backend regression: 25/25 pytest pass (13 V1+V2 + 12 V3 chat) — no regression from the frontend-only hotfix. Frontend regression on mobile viewport 390x844: all 4 role dashboards render WITHOUT any red-screen / render error. (1) Patient Dashboard renders with 6 module tiles (AI Chat, Doctors, Medical Organizations, Pharmacies, Medical Services, Home Medical Assistance) + inbox bell (open-inbox) + start-ai-consultation-card + Featured Doctors row. (2) Doctor Dashboard renders with 'Good morning · Dr. Akmal Karimov · Cardiologist' header, 3-stat row (7 Today / 1750k Earnings / 4.9 Rating), Next appointment gradient card (10:30 Aziza Karimova · Follow-up: Hypertension), and 6 module tiles including Inbox (doc-inbox testID) which uses totalUnread from the newly-imported useChat — confirmed no crash. (3) Admin Dashboard renders with 'Admin Console · Medion Private Clinic', 3-stat row (54 Active doctors / 12,480 patients / 3,120 visits), and Manage Doctors + Departments + Analytics + Marketing Tools + Inbox tiles. (4) Service Dashboard renders with 'Sevara Kamilova · Home Nurse' header, MONTH INCOME 18,600,000 UZS card, and Orders / Income / Gallery / Inbox tiles + Active orders list. V3 chat regression: patient home 'open-inbox' → /inbox opens with 'Live' pill (WS connected), one prior conversation with Dr. Akmal Karimov (unread=1) + Andijan Regional Hospital Reception (empty). Doctor list → Dr. Akmal card → Doctor Profile V2 shows Education + Certificates + Workplaces (with Primary tag on Andijan Regional Hospital) — no crash. Message button (doctor-message-btn) → /chat/dr-001 → sent 'Hello doctor, quick question about my headache' → user bubble + timestamp appeared immediately → ~15s later Claude Sonnet 4.5 persona reply arrived: 'Hello! I'm Dr. Akmal Karimov. I'm sorry to hear you're having a headache. How long have you been experiencing it, and is it accompanied by any other symptoms like nausea, sensitivity to light, or fever?' — verified in /tmp/r_chat_reply.png. Language screen shows the FULL branded logo (jellyfish + MedUZ AI wordmark + 'SIZNING INTELLEKTUAL TIBBIY YORDAMCHINGIZ' tagline + 5-icons row) — verified in /tmp/01_language.png. No page errors in browser, no console errors beyond the pre-existing (harmless) shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings. Deprecated packages check: none of expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch are present in the codebase.

rca_of_issue: Hotfix root cause was straightforward: the Doctor Dashboard called useChat() without importing it, causing a React runtime ReferenceError → red-screen. Main agent added `import { useChat } from '@/src/store/chat'` at app/(doctor)/index.tsx:20 and separated the mangled import in app/inbox.tsx:9 from `function formatWhen`. Verified: (a) both files now compile cleanly, (b) all 4 role dashboards render without any error boundary triggers, (c) the Inbox tile on the doctor dashboard correctly displays 'Patient messages' when totalUnread === 0 (screenshot /tmp/06_doctor_home.png), and (d) end-to-end V3 chat still works (Claude persona reply arrived in /tmp/r_chat_reply.png). No further action needed on this bug.
